name: S100 calcium binding protein A8

function.text: S100A8 is the approved symbol for S100 calcium binding protein A8. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in arachidonate binding; calcium ion binding; autocrine signaling.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Glioblastoma; Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: S100A8 encodes S100 calcium binding protein A8. Its functions include arachidonate binding and calcium ion binding.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving S100A8 have been reported in glioblastoma, thyroid carcinoma, and lung adenocarcinoma.
